title: プログラミング（再履修クラス）
subtitle: Programming
teachers: 授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
In this course, students conduct programming exercises within small groups.
Specifically, students will:
(1) Learn how to develop programs using their PCs.
(2) Learn how to create a simple arithmetic program.
(3) Learn how to create programs using control statements such as "if" and "for."
(4) Learn how to use standard library functions.
advice:
In this course, students conduct programming exercises within small groups with the aim of acquiring skills related to the C language and other practical skills.

We will cover the following materials:
 - basic syntax
 - control structures
 - functions
 - standard library functions
 - file input/output
 - command-line arguments
 - pointer
 - structure
 - basic algorithms

activityGoals.body: Be able to develop programs using their PC.
Be able to find and correct mistakes in programs.
Be able to create simple calculation programs.
Be able to create programs that use control statements such as "if" and "for."
Be able to use standard library functions appropriately.
Be able to create practical programs for data processing, such as averages and maximums.

              In this course, students conduct programming exercises within small groups.
Specifically, students will:
(1) Learn how to develop programs using their PCs.
(2) Learn how to create a simple arithmetic program.
(3) Learn how to create programs using control statements such as "if" and "for."
(4) Learn how to use standard library functions.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students conduct programming exercises within small groups with the aim of acquiring skills related to the C language and other practical skills.

We will cover the following materials:
 - basic syntax
 - control structures
 - functions
 - standard library functions
 - file input/output
 - command-line arguments
 - pointer
 - structure
 - basic algorithms
